object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Leave index.lock in the git folder, or unset user.email, and call set_attribute with a commit_message. Expected: the result reports the write as done and carries the commit's error. The object file holds the new value and HEAD doesn't move. After removing the cause, commit_changes commits the change. Only the absence of a commit error is tested.
